claim.claim-text: 1. A pharmaceutical composition comprising as an active ingredient a compound selected from the group consisting of:
and a compound represented by Formula II:

including a tautomer or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, wherein R<6a> to R<6c>, R<7>, R<8a> to R<8c>, independently and in each occurrence represent at least one substituent comprising or being selected from the group consisting of hydrogen, alkyl, cycloalkyl, alkoxy, hydroxy, thiohydroxy, thioalkoxy, aryloxy, thioaryloxy, amino, nitro, halo, trihalomethyl, cyano, amide, carboxy, sulfonyl, sulfoxy, sulfinyl, sulfonamide, substituted or non-substituted, and R<9a> to R<9h> independently and in each occurrence represent one or more substituents comprising or being selected from the group consisting of hydrogen or C<1-6> alkyl.
2. The pharmaceutical composition of claim 1, wherein the compound is represented by Formula II and wherein R<6a> to R<6c> are each hydrogen.
3. The pharmaceutical composition of any one of claims 1 and 2, wherein the compound is represented by Formula II and wherein R<7> is methyl.
4. The pharmaceutical composition of any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the compound is represented by Formula II and wherein R<8a> to R<8c> are each hydrogen.
5. The pharmaceutical composition of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the compound is represented by Formula II and wherein R<9a> to R<9h> are each hydrogen.
6. The pharmaceutical composition of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the compound is represented by Formula II and wherein the compound is in the form of Formula IIa or IIb:
7. The pharmaceutical composition of any one of claims 1 to 6, further comprising a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier.
8. The pharmaceutical composition of any one of claims 1 to 7, for use in treating a medical condition.
9. The pharmaceutical composition for use according to claim 8, wherein said medical condition is associated with a glycogen storage disease (GSD).
10. The pharmaceutical composition for use according to claim 9, wherein the GSD is selected from the group consisting of: GSD type IV, GSD type VII, and Lafora Disease (LD).
11. The pharmaceutical composition for use according to claim 9, wherein the GSD is selected from Adult polyglucosan body disease (APBD), Andersen disease, Forbes disease, and Danon disease.
12. The pharmaceutical composition for use according to claim 8, wherein said medical condition is a neurodegenerative disease.
13. The pharmaceutical composition for use according to claim 8, wherein said medical condition is glycogen-associated cancer.

14. The pharmaceutical composition for use according to any one of claims 8 to 13, wherein the composition is formulated for parenteral, mucosal, nasal, or oral administration; or wherein the composition is formulated for dental administration, administration by inhalation, or topical administration including ophtalmically, vaginally, rectally, and intranasally.
15. A diagnostic kit comprising a compound selected from the group consisting of:
and a compound represented by Formula II:

including a tautomer or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, wherein R<6a> to R<6c>, R<7>, R<8a> to R<8c>, independently and in each occurrence represent at least one substituent comprising or being selected from the group consisting of hydrogen, alkyl, cycloalkyl, alkoxy, hydroxy, thiohydroxy, thioalkoxy, aryloxy, thioaryloxy, amino, nitro, halo, trihalomethyl, cyano, amide, carboxy, sulfonyl, sulfoxy, sulfinyl, sulfonamide, substituted or non-substituted, and R<9a> to R<9h> independently and in each occurrence represent one or more substituents comprising or being selected from the group consisting of hydrogen or C<1-6> alkyl, preferably wherein the diagnostic kit is suitable for detecting GSD.
